Q: How do durable checkpoints, node replay and external effect identity interact?
A: A checkpoint preserves graph execution state under its storage contract; it does not atomically include every external service effect. A node may be replayed after failure or resumption, depending on the execution boundary. Isolate nondeterministic and effectful operations according to the framework's durable-execution guidance and give consequential external operations stable identities. Risk: Persistence is often mistaken for universal exactly-once execution.
